title: T. rex Bit With 8,000 Pounds of Force, More Than Twice a Crocodile

scenes.text: T. rex bit down with 8,000 pounds of force.
That is more than twice the strongest living animal bite.
A saltwater crocodile, the record holder today, manages about 3,700 pounds.
The pressure at a T. rex tooth tip reached about 431,000 pounds per square inch.
That is enough to crush bone, and swallow the pieces.
Scientists worked it out from crocodile bites. T. rex bit harder than anything alive.

description:
A 2017 study estimated that T. rex bit with about 8,000 pounds of force.
A saltwater crocodile, the strongest living biter, manages about 3,700 pounds.
Which prehistoric animal would you least like to meet?
first_comment: Would you rather face a T. rex or a giant crocodile?
